findings.sourceEvidence: No Loan Party will, nor will it permit any Restricted Subsidiary to, create, incur, assume or suffer to exist any Indebtedness, except:
findings.verifierReasoning: The chapeau prohibits Loan Parties from creating/incurring Indebtedness AND prohibits Loan Parties from permitting any Restricted Subsidiary to do so. The practical effect is that both Loan Parties and Restricted Subsidiaries are restricted from incurring non-excepted Indebtedness. Scoping the top-level prohibition rule to LOAN_PARTY only implies Restricted Subsidiaries have no restriction on Indebtedness under this section at all, which is contrary to the source and would let a reviewer wrongly conclude a Restricted Subsidiary can freely incur debt outside the listed exceptions.
